title: OpenDose project file
description: Generated from web/src/project/fileFormat.ts by web/scripts/project-schema.mjs; do not edit. The format is described in docs/project-file-format.md.

groups.description: User-defined navigator groups, in display order (optional: absent in older files; repaired on load, see groups.ts).

recipes.description: Import recipes saved with the project (project/recipes.ts).

groupColors.description: Colours pinned to group names ("KO" = #e69f00): every graph draws a data set of that name in it unless the graph sets its own (graph/nameColors.ts). Absent in files from before (no pins).

reproductions.description: Reproduction checks of this project, newest last: each time it was opened (file, autosave or share link) in a build other than the one that saved it, its results were recomputed and compared (project/reproduce.ts). Kept outside undo history. Absent in files from before they were saved, and when there has been no check.

opendose_project.description: Marks the file as an OpenDose project and gives its format version.

savedWith.description: The software that saved the file; a later build that opens it recomputes the saved results and compares them (project/reproduce.ts).

selected.description: The sheet on screen when the file was saved, reopened first.

ProjectFile.description: An OpenDose project file (format version 2). Share links carry the same JSON without `prefs`.

groupId.description: User-defined navigator group (a SheetGroup of this sheet's section).

floatingNotes.description: Sticky notes shown over this sheet (never printed or exported).

derived.description: Set when this table is the output of a table-producing analysis (a "chain"): it is recomputed from its source and read-only until unlinked. See derived.ts.

simulation.description: Set when this table was simulated: what to re-run for "Simulate again". The table itself is ordinary, editable data.

report.description: Reporting details (unit of n, independent experiments, exclusions, sample-size reasoning) for legends, methods and journal checklists (src/report).

imported.description: Where the values came from: the file (name, SHA-256), the recipe or import settings, and the values as imported, so hand edits since can be counted (project/importRecord.ts, P-76). Absent in files saved before it existed, and on tables typed or pasted in.

x.description: Top-left corner inside the workbench, in CSS px.

collapsed.description: Folded into its chip above the sheet.

FloatingNote.description: A floating note on a sheet: on-screen annotation only.

decimals.description: Decimal places shown in the grid (undefined = as typed). Display only: analyses and exports use every stored digit.

xTimeUnit.description: Dates / elapsed X: unit of the numbers analyses and graphs see.

xDateOrder.description: Dates X: reading of ambiguous dates such as 1/2/2024.

xElapsedTwoPart.description: Elapsed X: whether a two-part time such as 12:30 is h:mm or m:ss.

replicates.description: Biological replicates (independent experiments) of a column or grouped table, for SuperPlots and statistics on replicate means (sheets/common/superplot.ts). Absent = each Y subcolumn is one.

factorNames.description: Names of the factors the rows and the data sets stand for, when the table came from a file that named them (the header above the row titles; a long file's factor columns). Two-way analyses use them until the user names the factors.

DataTableModel.description: The generic grid every table type is stored in.

XFormat.description: What the X column holds. Dates / elapsed times are stored as typed and converted to numbers for analyses and graphs (project/xformat.ts).

exclusionReasons.description: Why a cell was excluded, by the same "row:sub" key (optional; absent = no reason recorded). Kept in step with `excluded` by project/exclusions.ts and the row operations in project/table.ts.

formula.description: A calculated column: its values come from this formula over the other columns (project/calculated.ts) and are rewritten whenever they change. Absent = typed values.

formulaError.description: Why the formula could not be calculated (set by the sync; cells then keep their last values).

DataColumn.description: One Y column (a dataset / group / variable) with its subcolumns.

VarType.description: Multiple-variables tables: each column is one variable.

SubcolumnFormat.description: How Y subcolumns are entered: raw replicate values, or summary values computed elsewhere (mean with SD / SEM / %CV / CI limits / errors / limits, with or without N), analyzed through the engine's summary-data handlers.

ReplicateLayout.description: Replicates entered side by side in subcolumns, or stacked down rows.

XTimeUnit.description: Unit dates / elapsed times are converted to for analyses and graphs.

DateOrder.description: How an ambiguous date such as 1/2/2024 is read.

ReplicateMap.description: Which values belong to which biological replicate (experiment). "subcolumns": Y subcolumn k of every data set belongs to replicate `of[k]` (missing entries: replicate k), so technical repeats can share an experiment. "column": the data set at index `column` holds each row's experiment label (long format; column tables only) and is not a group. `names` label the replicates (default: subcolumn titles, the labels found in the column, or "Experiment n"). `unit` says what one value is ("cells", "wells", "fields"), so the figure legend can write "n = 18 cells from 3 independent experiments" (src/report).

DerivedLink.description: A derived table's provenance: the data sheet it is computed from and the results sheet (on that data sheet) whose analysis produces it. `output` names which of the analysis' tables it is when one analysis makes several (AnalysisDef.derivedTable), e.g. "potency" for a curve fit's per-experiment logIC50 values; absent (every file saved before it existed) = the analysis' one table.

SimulationSpec.description: How a simulated table was made. `form` is the simulation dialog's state (owned by sheets/manipulate); `seed` the seed of the last run.

unit.description: What one n counts, as a plural noun: "mice", "wells", "patients".

experiments.description: Independent experiments (biological replicates) behind the data.

exclusions.description: Exclusions and their reasons ("none" is an answer).

sampleSize.description: How the sample size was decided (when no power analysis is in the project): "based on a pilot study", "resource equation", ...

valueIs.description: The answer to "What does each value represent?" (results guidance; sheets/common/declareUnit.ts), or "dismissed" when the user closed the question without answering.

basis.description: "Plain import", or the recipe's name ("Plate reader grid …").

recipeName.description: The saved recipe applied, if one was.

spec.description: The settings: share/recipes/saved.ts SavedSpec (normalizeSpec reads it).

read.description: How the file was read: text encoding, rows hidden in a workbook.

replayable.description: Re-running the settings on the same file gave this table exactly (checked when the record was made); otherwise `why` says why not.

cells.description: Fingerprint of the values as imported (cellsFingerprint).

snapshot.description: The values as imported, kept up to SNAPSHOT_CELLS cells.

ImportHow.description: How the values got in: the Import dialog, a recipe, or Apply to new data putting a file into the table in its own layout.

ImportMode.description: A new table, the table's values replaced, or rows added.

name.description: The file name as chosen, or "pasted text".

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes (of the text's UTF-8 bytes when pasted).

worksheet.description: The worksheet read, for a workbook.

CellSnapshot.description: The values as imported: X, row titles and every Y cell (y[d][r][s]).

EarlierImport.description: An import before the current one, with the cells edited by hand between it and the next (null: too large a table to count).

groupId.description: User-defined navigator group (a SheetGroup of this sheet's section).

floatingNotes.description: Sticky notes shown over this sheet (never printed or exported).

plan.description: An analysis plan written before the data (project/plan.ts).

design.description: The study design record: randomisation, blinding, criteria, animals (project/studyDesign.ts). Absent in files saved before it existed.

groups.description: The groups (data set names) of the experiment.

comparison.description: The primary comparison (two groups), if there is one.

nPerGroup.description: Independent units per group (null: not stated).

writtenAt.description: ISO time the plan was written.

resultsId.description: The results sheet that runs the planned analysis.

designNotes.description: One-line design checks from "Plan an experiment…" (guide/designChecks).

options.description: The analysis options as planned (the comparison's key options).

what.description: What changed, in words ("Test: Welch t test → paired t test").

randomised.description: Units allocated to groups at random, or not; absent: not stated.

randomisationMethod.description: Randomised: how the sequence was generated. Not randomised: how units were allocated instead.

seed.description: The seed of the randomisation sequence, as typed.

blinding.description: Who knew the allocation at each stage; a stage absent is not stated.

exclusionCriteria.description: Inclusion and exclusion criteria for animals and data points.

age.description: Age or developmental stage ("8 to 10 weeks").

Blinded.description: "blinded": the people at that stage did not know the allocation.

groupId.description: User-defined navigator group (a SheetGroup of this sheet's section).

floatingNotes.description: Sticky notes shown over this sheet (never printed or exported).

cached.description: Last computed result. Always present on frozen sheets (it is what they show); written for every results sheet when a project is saved.

cachedKey.description: Fingerprint of the input `cached` was computed from (app/analysis.ts resultKey); a reopened project reuses the result while it matches.

chosen.description: Why "Help me choose…" or "Plan an experiment…" picked this analysis (guide/choice.ts). Absent in files from before it was saved, and on sheets the wizard did not open.

leftOut.description: Values left out of this analysis only (a sensitivity analysis): they stay in the table and in every other analysis, and each carries the reason given (project/leftOut.ts). Absent in files from before it existed, and on sheets that leave nothing out.

test.description: The test as the chooser named it ("Unpaired t test").

reason.description: One paragraph: why this test fits the user's answers.

options.description: The options the chooser set over the analysis' defaults.

ChosenTest.description: The test chooser's reason for an analysis, kept with the results sheet it opened. It applies while the sheet runs `analysis` with `options` (the options the chooser set) unchanged; after the user changes one of them the reason no longer describes the test and is not shown.

dataset.description: The cell: data set index, row and subcolumn (0-based).

value.description: The cell's text when it was left out. A cell that no longer holds it (rows moved, the value edited) is not left out, and the Exclusions block says so, rather than leaving out whatever is there now.

reason.description: Why it is left out (never empty).

LeftOutValue.description: One Y cell left out of one analysis, with why.

groupId.description: User-defined navigator group (a SheetGroup of this sheet's section).

floatingNotes.description: Sticky notes shown over this sheet (never printed or exported).

snapshot.description: Frozen graphs keep a copy of their inputs so later edits leave them.

format.description: Format Graph / Format Axes / annotations (sparse; absent = as drawn). Validate with readFormat() from src/graph before use.

pStyle.description: This graph's own P-value style, overriding the project's (Preferences → Reporting, report/prefs.ts); absent = follow the project.

order.description: Plotting order of dataset indices: first = left / drawn first (back).

spacing.description: Column graphs: gap between columns as a fraction of a slot (0..0.9).

connect.description: Column graphs: join groups by their mean/median, or each subject.

GraphTheme.description: Whole-graph look. "classic": white background, black axes and bold sans-serif text, no grid, offset axes that end at the last tick, minor ticks, no legend title (theme.ts). Absent = the app's default look.

show.description: false hides the dataset on this graph (the analysis still uses it).

color.description: Base colour (#rrggbb). Replaces the scheme colour wherever it is used.

fillAlpha.description: Opacity of marker / bar / box fills, 0..1 (semitransparent colours).

lineDash.description: Fitted curve, connecting line, survival line.

connect.description: Connecting line through the points (XY-type plots).

errorCap.description: Cap width in px (0 = no caps).

xErrorFrom.description: Index of another dataset whose values are this one's X error (SD); that dataset is then hidden.

nudge.description: Shift along X (data units; category units on column graphs).

rightAxis.description: Plot on the right Y axis.

labelPoints.description: Label each point with its row title.

DatasetFormat.description: Per-dataset appearance. Every field is optional: unset = automatic.

ConnectLine.description: How points of one dataset are joined (the fitted curve is separate).

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point (decimal / scientific).

majorStep.description: Distance between major ticks (decades on a log axis).

minorCount.description: Minor ticks per major interval (0 = none).

gap.description: Discontinuous axis: leave out the range between `from` and `to`.

elapsedUnit.description: Elapsed-time numbering: the unit the values are in.

title.description: Title (right Y axis only; X and Y titles live in settings.titles).

lineWidth.description: Width of the axis line and its ticks in px (graph/sizeUnit.ts shows it in pt); setting it draws the line. Absent = as the plot draws it.

scaleFactor.description: Scale factor k (linear axes): tick labels show value / 10^k and the title gets "(×10^k)"; the data are unchanged.

grid.description: Also draw a grid line across the plot.

arrow.description: Draw an arrow from the text to (x, y); the text sits (ax, ay) px away.

CoordRef.description: Where an annotation's coordinates live: data units (they move with the axes) or the plot area as 0..1 fractions.

ResultsAnnotation.description: A live text block filled from the current results.

hidden.description: Pair keys (`pairKey`) the user unticked. New pairs show by default.

display.description: "mixed": asterisks when significant, the exact P when not.

threshold.description: Only draw pairs with P below this (null/absent = all, ns included).

hideNs.description: Leave out pairs that are not significant ("ns"); absent = the project's "hide ns" (Preferences → Reporting).

engine.description: Letters returned by the engine's `compact_letters` handler, used while `input` still matches the comparisons (see letters.ts).

byGroup.description: Colour group rows with their curve colour (default true).

groupId.description: User-defined navigator group (a SheetGroup of this sheet's section).

floatingNotes.description: Sticky notes shown over this sheet (never printed or exported).

graphIds.description: Graphs placed on the page (kept in sync with `items`).

page.description: Absent in files from before the page composer: defaults apply and the items are built from graphIds + grid.

PageSize.description: Page size of a layout. All layout lengths are millimetres measured from the page's top-left corner (see project/layout.ts).

LayoutItem.description: One thing placed on a layout page.

digits.description: Significant digits shown in results tables.

colorByName.description: The same colour for a group on every graph, by its name (graph/nameColors.ts). Absent = colours follow the data set order.

export.description: Last image-export settings (see export/settings.ts); travel with the project, outside undo history.

report.description: P-value style, "ns" display and default effect-size family (src/report/prefs.ts); absent = defaults.

scaleText.description: Scale the graph as drawn on screen to the export size (text shrinks or grows with it) instead of laying it out again at that size.

hideNs.description: Leave the "ns" summary out (tables, brackets, legends).

pFloor.description: GraphPad style: the smallest P written exactly (default 0.0001).

PStyle.description: P-value style presets (pformat.ts has the rules and their sources).

SmdPref.description: Standardized mean difference shown first: Cohen's d or Hedges' g.

VariancePref.description: Variance explained shown first: eta squared (partial in factorial designs) or omega squared (partial in factorial designs).

PFloor.description: The smallest P written exactly in the GraphPad style; below it the results say "P < floor". "exact" writes every P to the results precision. APA and NEJM keep their journals' own floors.

collapsed.description: Folded in the navigator (saved with the project, outside undo).

SheetGroup.description: A user-defined group of sheets inside one navigator section. Sheets join it through their `groupId`; deleting a group keeps its sheets.

GroupSection.description: Navigator sections that can hold user-defined groups.

basis.description: What it was built on ("Incucyte time series", "Plain import").

name.description: The group (data set) name as typed; matched ignoring case and the spaces around it.

color.description: #rrggbb, the same in light and dark.

file.description: The file name, or the project's title for an autosave or a link.

ReproductionSource.description: How the checked project was opened: a project file (absent, as in every record written before the other two were checked), a restored autosave session, or a share link.

commit.description: Build commit, when the build had one.

engine.description: Hash of the engine's Python files.

libraries.description: Python libraries of the engine that computed the results.

SavedWith.description: The software a project file was saved with.

analysis.description: Result id (`result.analysis`), for the change log.

note.description: Why it failed or was skipped.

SheetCheck.description: The comparison of one results sheet.

context.description: Names of the items on the way ("Treated vs Control", "Drug A").
